cohort: 669 women of reproductive age (15-49 years) in the Simiyu region, Tanzania
finding: The prevalence of early initiation of breastfeeding (EIBF) in the Simiyu region of Tanzania was 62.2%, with lower odds of EIBF among women who had a caesarean section or gave birth to male children, and higher odds among those who reported skin-to-skin contact.
mod_finding: Women who had a caesarean section had lower odds of EIBF (OR = 0.41; 95% CI = 0.17-0.98).
